rows.other-attackers-damage-counts-toward-let: CR 702.19b: damage the Eager Cadet assigns to the shared blocker in the same step counts toward lethal, so War Mammoth may assign 1 to Trueheart Duelist and trample 2 over. Observed: the defending player lost only 1 life; the Mammoth was given no assignment choice and its controller could not trample 2 over.
